class.name: Spout
class.brief_description: Windows Spout sender, receiver, and shared-data bridge.
class.description: Exposes the Spout 2 SDK to scripts on Windows x86_64. Spout can share images, OpenGL textures and framebuffers, sender metadata, and named memory buffers with other Spout applications. [b]Note:[/b] The raw texture, framebuffer, and shared-texture methods accept OpenGL object identifiers. Use them only with the Compatibility renderer and a valid OpenGL context. They do not accept Vulkan or Direct3D native resource handles. A texture target is normally [code]0x0DE1[/code] ([code]GL_TEXTURE_2D[/code]). A successful cross-process texture transfer requires a compatible Windows GPU, driver, and running Spout peer. Without a peer, receiver status methods return their normal disconnected values and transfer methods can return [constant FAILED].

method.name: adapter_name
method.description: Returns the name of the currently selected graphics adapter.

method.name: bind_shared_texture
method.description: Binds the receiver's shared OpenGL texture. Returns [code]true[/code] on success.

method.name: create_memory_buffer
method.description: Creates a named shared memory buffer of [param length] bytes. The length must be between 1 byte and 16 MiB.

method.name: delete_memory_buffer
method.description: Deletes the shared memory buffer owned by this instance.

method.name: disable_frame_count
method.description: Disables Spout frame counting.

method.name: disable_spout_log
method.description: Disables Spout SDK logging.

method.name: enable_spout_log
method.description: Enables Spout SDK logging.

method.name: enable_spout_log_file
method.description: Enables Spout SDK logging to [param filename]. Existing content is preserved when [param append] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: find_sender_name
method.description: Returns whether a sender named [param sender_name] is currently registered.

method.name: get_active_sender
method.description: Returns the system-wide active Spout sender name, or an empty string when none is active.

method.name: get_adapter
method.description: Returns the index of the graphics adapter selected by Spout.

method.name: get_adapter_name
method.description: Returns the graphics adapter name at [param index]. The output buffer is clamped to a safe maximum.

method.name: get_auto_share
method.description: Returns whether Spout automatically falls back to CPU sharing when GPU sharing is unavailable.

method.name: get_host_path
method.description: Returns the executable path of the process publishing [param sender_name], or an empty string if unavailable. The output buffer is clamped to a safe maximum.

method.name: get_memory_buffer_size
method.description: Returns the size in bytes of the named shared memory buffer, or [code]0[/code] if it does not exist.

method.name: get_num_adapters
method.description: Returns the number of graphics adapters visible to Spout.

method.name: get_sender
method.description: Returns the registered sender name at [param index]. The output buffer is clamped to a safe maximum.

method.name: get_sender_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered Spout senders.

method.name: get_senders
method.description: Returns all registered sender names. The array size equals [method get_sender_count].

method.name: get_shared_texture_id
method.description: Returns the OpenGL identifier of the receiver's shared texture, or [code]0[/code] when unavailable.

method.name: get_spout_logs
method.description: Returns the current Spout SDK log contents.

method.name: get_spout_version
method.description: Returns the numeric Spout SDK version.

method.name: get_vertical_sync
method.description: Returns the current vertical synchronization interval reported by Spout.

method.name: hold_fps
method.description: Limits the calling thread to [param fps] frames per second. [param fps] must be positive.

method.name: is_frame_count_enabled
method.description: Returns whether Spout frame counting is enabled.

method.name: is_gldx_ready
method.description: Returns whether Spout's OpenGL/DirectX interop is ready on the current system.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns whether the Spout instance has initialized its sharing resources.

method.name: read_memory_buffer
method.description: Reads at most [param max_length] bytes from the named shared memory buffer. Returns only the bytes actually read, or an empty array on failure. The maximum accepted length is 16 MiB.

method.name: receiver_get_sender_cpu
method.description: Returns whether the connected sender uses CPU sharing.

method.name: receiver_get_sender_fps
method.description: Returns the connected sender's measured frame rate.

method.name: receiver_get_sender_frame
method.description: Returns the connected sender's current frame number.

method.name: receiver_get_sender_gldx
method.description: Returns whether the connected sender uses OpenGL/DirectX interop.

method.name: receiver_get_sender_name
method.description: Returns the connected sender name, or an empty string when disconnected.

method.name: receiver_get_sender_size
method.description: Returns the connected sender dimensions, or [constant Vector2.ZERO] when unavailable.

method.name: receiver_is_connected
method.description: Returns whether a sender is currently connected.

method.name: receiver_is_frame_new
method.description: Returns whether the most recently received frame is new.

method.name: receiver_is_updated
method.description: Returns whether the connected sender name or dimensions changed.

method.name: receiver_receive_image
method.description: Receives the connected sender into [param image]. On success, the image is replaced with the received dimensions and pixel data. Supported [param gl_format] values are [code]6408[/code] (RGBA), [code]32993[/code] (BGRA), [code]6407[/code] (RGB), and [code]32992[/code] (BGR).

method.name: receiver_receive_texture
method.description: Receives into an existing OpenGL texture. Pass both [param texture_id] and [param texture_target], or pass [code]0[/code] for both to update receiver state without copying to a texture. This method is only valid with the Compatibility renderer.

method.name: receiver_release_receiver
method.description: Disconnects the receiver and releases its resources.

method.name: receiver_set_receiver_name
method.description: Selects [param sender_name] for receiving. An empty name lets Spout select the active sender.

method.name: sender_get_cpu
method.description: Returns whether this sender is using CPU sharing.

method.name: sender_get_fps
method.description: Returns this sender's measured frame rate.

method.name: sender_get_frame
method.description: Returns this sender's current frame number.

method.name: sender_get_gldx
method.description: Returns whether this sender uses OpenGL/DirectX interop.

method.name: sender_get_name
method.description: Returns this instance's sender name.

method.name: sender_release_sender
method.description: Releases this sender after an optional [param msec] delay.

method.name: sender_send_fbo
method.description: Sends the OpenGL texture attached to framebuffer [param fbo_id], using [member send_size]. This method is only valid with the Compatibility renderer.

method.name: sender_send_image
method.description: Sends [param image] through Spout. Supported [param gl_format] values are [code]6408[/code] (RGBA), [code]32993[/code] (BGRA), [code]6407[/code] (RGB), and [code]32992[/code] (BGR). On success, [member send_size] is updated to the image dimensions.

method.name: sender_send_texture
method.description: Sends an existing OpenGL texture using [member send_size]. [param texture_target] is normally [code]0x0DE1[/code] ([code]GL_TEXTURE_2D[/code]). This method is only valid with the Compatibility renderer.

method.name: sender_set_sender_name
method.description: Sets the sender name. The default name is [code]Godot_Spout[/code].

method.name: set_active_sender
method.description: Makes [param sender_name] the system-wide active sender. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for an empty name.

method.name: set_auto_share
method.description: Enables or disables automatic CPU-sharing fallback.

method.name: set_frame_count
method.description: Enables or disables Spout frame counting.

method.name: set_frame_sync
method.description: Signals the named Spout frame synchronization event without waiting.

method.name: set_spout_log_level
method.description: Sets the minimum severity recorded by the Spout SDK logger.

method.name: set_vertical_sync
method.description: Enables or disables vertical synchronization. Returns [constant OK] when the setting was applied.

method.name: show_spout_logs
method.description: Opens the Spout log folder in Windows Explorer.

method.name: spout_log
method.description: Writes a message at the SDK's default log level.

method.name: spout_log_error
method.description: Writes an error-level message to the Spout log.

method.name: spout_log_fatal
method.description: Writes a fatal-level message to the Spout log.

method.name: spout_log_notice
method.description: Writes a notice-level message to the Spout log.

method.name: spout_log_verbose
method.description: Writes a verbose-level message to the Spout log.

method.name: spout_log_warning
method.description: Writes a warning-level message to the Spout log.

method.name: unbind_shared_texture
method.description: Unbinds the receiver's shared OpenGL texture. Returns [code]true[/code] on success.

method.name: write_memory_buffer
method.description: Writes [param length] bytes from [param data] to the named shared memory buffer. The length must not exceed the data size or 16 MiB.

members.member: Dimensions used by raw OpenGL framebuffer and texture sends. Both components must be positive and within the engine's image size limits.
